_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE running any Gen50 test. Project trials before Gen50: ~260 (deflated Sharpe uses 280).

G50a_cct_ensemble.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon (2025, SSRN 5209907) 'Catching Crypto Trends' as summarised by CXO Advisory: equal-weight ensemble of Donchian-style models on closes with lookbacks 5,10,20,30,60,90,150,250,360 days; enter long on a new n-day closing high, exit when the close falls below the n-day channel midpoint; long-only; volatility-based sizing
G50a_cct_ensemble.deviation: full paper not reachable; sizing = the Lab's per-coin 40%/30-day vol scaling (same as C*), universe = C*'s 10 majors, so only the signal design differs
G50a_cct_ensemble.data: crypto 10 majors daily 2018-2026, cost 7.5 bp, leverage 0.79
G50a_cct_ensemble.report: Sharpe, CAGR, MDD, correlation of daily returns with C*

G50b_cstar_plus_cct.rule: average of the C* signal and the CCT ensemble signal (50/50), same sizing/leverage
G50b_cstar_plus_cct.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= C* + 0.10 AND max drawdown not worse than C*'s, 2018-2026

G50c_sharpe_weighted_multi.rule: sleeves C*, noise-area US100, vol-managed SP500, curve momentum; weight_i proportional to prior Sharpe_i / trailing-12m vol_i, priors fixed from earlier single pre-registered tests (1.67, 0.71, 0.63, 0.37), monthly, scaled to 15% vol by trailing vol (cap 3x)
G50c_sharpe_weighted_multi.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= C* (same window) + 0.10 AND max drawdown not worse

G50d_cstar_equity_regime.rule: C* exposure x1 when S&P 500 futures close is above its 200-day average (yesterday), x0.5 otherwise
G50d_cstar_equity_regime.pass_rule: net Sharpe >= C* + 0.10 AND max drawdown not worse, 2018-2026
